question: Should this PR intentionally retire the old recent-session/group-collapse sidebar preferences and default to only Overview pinned, or should it preserve more upgrade-compatible defaults before merge?
rationale: The behavior is a broad Control UI default and persisted-preference change, and the PR already carries the protected maintainer label, so automation should not infer the intended upgrade policy.

options.title: Proceed after repair and rebase

options.title: Preserve more upgrade behavior
